Friends of Artsy Fartsy Foundation

Creativity can open doors. Help us hold them open.

Our mission is to ensure an accessible, inspiring space for Artsy Fartsy Creative Laboratory; expand equitable access to the arts through scholarships for high school students and adult learners; and strengthen arts education with high-quality color science professional development for teachers.

We believe creativity is a powerful catalyst for learning, expression, and community—and we work to nurture it across ages, disciplines, and classrooms.

A place to process, play & discover

It’s not just what you make. It’s what happens while you make it.

At Artsy Fartsy, creative exploration is about more than a finished piece. It’s a chance to test an idea, notice color and texture, build confidence, and learn through doing.

Our studio welcomes young artists, adult learners, and curious minds to explore materials and ideas in an encouraging environment.
